As a backend engineer with six years of experience at Northwind Robotics, I developed and owned the order-routing service using TypeScript on Node.js and PostgreSQL, handling approximately 2 million events per day. My work focused on building scalable, reliable systems under high load, with deep expertise in PostgreSQL for schema design, query tuning, and logical replication. I also led a successful nine-month Strangler-fig migration from a monolith to an event-driven architecture, achieving zero customer-visible downtime while reducing p99 checkout latency from 1.9 seconds to 340 milliseconds—demonstrating both technical rigor and operational discipline.

In my role as engineering lead at Vertex Logistics, I managed a team of five engineers across dispatch and billing product lines, driving delivery and technical excellence. I leveraged Kubernetes and Terraform to streamline service deployment, ensuring consistent, reproducible environments across development and production. This experience strengthened my ability to lead cross-functional teams while maintaining high standards for system reliability and performance.

I am drawn to Saffron Bistro Group’s mission and the opportunity to contribute to a modern, scalable backend platform. My background in building resilient, high-throughput systems, combined with leadership experience and a track record of successful large-scale migrations, positions me to make immediate impact in a software engineering role,
